reviews.text: We love Mixlab for my pup’s IBD meds. The cute little toys included always make her day 🤗 …

MixLab's customer service is top-notch. You can text or call and it is ALWAYS a human that responds. You never have to deal with AI or a horrible, endless phone tree.  Not only do you get to speak with a real person, the person is always kind, understanding, helpful, and patient.  MixLab recently went above and beyond to help out with a situation where my vet's office had a long delay in getting the prescription to them.  MixLab did everything in their power to make sure my dog had his medicine on time. I am really grateful to everyone there.  They also include a cute joke and a small dog toy with every package. My dog doesn't play with toys anymore, but we donate all the toys to rescues so MixLab is helping out the dog community more than they even know!

I don't know how this company has positive reviews — something doesn't add up. After 5 months of dealing with this pharmacy for my chihuahua's seizure medication, I can tell you firsthand: this place is an absolute failure.
Let me be clear about what's at stake here — seizure medication cannot be missed or delayed. It's not a vitamin. When a pharmacy repeatedly lies about when a prescription is ready, that is a danger to your pet's life.
Here is what we have experienced, over and over again:

Falsified ready notifications — told the medication is ready, show up in person, it is not there.
"Automated refill delivery" that never happens — signed up, never fulfilled, never even filled.
Zero customer service — no one answers the phone. Texts ignored. Emails ignored.
Sent couriers to pick up medication I was told was ready — turned out not to be filled.
Five months of this. Not once. Not twice. Every single time.

I have gone out of my way in every possible direction to make this work — in-person visits, couriers, calls, texts, emails — and this company has failed at every turn. If you have a pet on routine or critical medication, go anywhere else. The 5-star reviews here are not believable given what this company actually delivers (which is nothing).

These guys are THE BEST!!! It's hard taking care of a sick kitty when you yourself have chronic illness, and sometimes you slip up, I forgot to have them ask the vet for a refil and ran out of my baby's transdermal, and the Mixlab team swooped in like superheros and made it possible for me to pick up same day, not to mention the kindness you showed me the whole way through. It brought me to tears to know that there are still good people like you in the world that really care. THANK YOU!!!
Great company with great values.

Super fast shipping. Easy 2-click Administration of Compounded transdermal medication for my cat with hypothyroidism. They even sent an extra bonus catnip toy for my girl. I am very happy with my experience with this company.

I’d give the incompetent staff at Mixlab zero stars if I could. Poor communication regarding any upcoming refills, no communication regarding the status of approval of medications, no shipment tracking link sent unless you ask,  drivers not delivering the medications due to lack of signature when none of the medications even require one, and medications not getting delivered by the date expected. If I didn’t get an animal health discount I would never use Mixlab and they can never even seem to remember to apply that to my account despite being able to make notes in their system.

These Mixlab peeps know how to get it done and done right. What a fantastic place. I order a prescription for my 17 year old kitty from Mixlab. I get great communication from them, stellar customer service (quick response time, personable and helpful), quick delivery, secure packaging - always with a lovely note, including a cute joke, and a toy! - and of course, a quality product. Would that all businesses were run this way - with class, compassion & integrity, delivering  in every way! Keep up the great work Mixlab! THANK YOU!

I am hands down impressed with MixLab for multiple reasons & highly recommend them:
- The process for ordering prescriptions is nearly effortless.
- Responsiveness of company is great; speed to create and receive an order is very good.
- Most important to me: they responded with speed, kindness, compassion, when our cat was critically ill and needed medicine and then in issuing a refund when she had passed on. You get to work either way real people not an AI bot!

It is heartening to find companies and people that do business personally and care about people and our beloved 4 legged friends.

My vet uses two different compounding veterinary pharmacies.  Two of my dog's prescriptions run out at about the same time every month.  One gets here in a week or so, unless something weird happens (and something weird happens pretty often), when it can take two weeks.  The Mixlab Rx shows up in a couple of days, attractively packaged with a dad joke and something nice for Stella.  My only question was answered immediately and otherwise they've been flawless.

The customer service here has been top notch so far. I picked up my kitty’s medicine last month and they were very kind. They delivered her refill and that was just as smooth a process. They also gifted her a cute little cat nip infused toy! So sweet. Definitely recommend them.

Our cat George is a new patient with Mixlab. When our previous compounding pharmacy closed I was worried dealing with a new pharmacy would be a headache. I WAS WRONG!!! Mixlab has been wonderful!!!! George's daily medication is always sent to us on time and is accurate. They even send him a little cat toy, which he loves. Thank you making our switch a pawsitive experience!!!

Great product service however the phone # on product is you Mixlab Inc but does not reflect any contact # of Kola whom I call to order. Please add # to product of where u call to order and u will be a 10! Frustrating!

My vet uses Mixlab’s service because he can earn commissions. My vet submitted the order for a cancer drug my dog desperately needs on a Thursday and I paid immediately through the link Mixlab sent to my phone. According to the confirmation page, I would receive the drug the next day (I live in LA county as well). It’s been 4 days and it’s not even shipped yet.

I’ll avoid this pharmacy due to the poor experience.

I spoke to Miriam this morning one regarding my Pet Ziggy that needed a refill on her medication. Miriam sent arequest to my vet  to help me out. I also have a sick baby. His name is Gibbs he had two medication’s that came in
Through an emergency and she’s taking care of that quickly for me she has excellent customer service skills she was very kind sympathetic and deserves to be recognized. I would hire her in my business in a moment.

My Chihuahua, Lenny, is epileptic and requires medication every 8 hours to prevent seizures. Missing a dose is not an option. Despite having an auto-refill account with a credit card on file, Mixlab has failed me consistently.
> For the last three deliveries, I’ve had to pick up the prescriptions in person because they were running late—even though they charged my card 10 days in advance. Today, I actually ran out of pills because of their delays. Despite calling several times over the last three days and being promised a delivery, nothing arrived.
> To make matters worse, I spent three hours driving in rush hour to the lab for a 5:30 PM pickup, only to be told, "Sorry, come back tomorrow, the pills aren't ready." This is completely  Unacceptable and life-threatening for a pet.

VDCrx closed after 35 years, and while I had my grievances with them, Mixlab has been a headache.
- Constant e-mails for prescriptions or incorrectly sent ones when I JUST ordered days ago
- They sent me a new prescription with a deceased animal's name on it, even though the order was clear
- Refills don't work and I have to keep on top of when medication is running out. I'm now behind on a dosage cause it, and the amount in each bottle is incorrect for the dosage required.
- They're extremely expensive. The only upside, I guess, is it's "free" shipping.

Please, do better. Medication can make the difference between life and death.

The only thing I will say they do better than VDCrx is when an animal passes, they are willing to refund you if you just got medication refilled.

Edit:
Unfortunately, things haven't improved. Every medication has an auto refill button, and they don't tell you that certain medication can't be auto refilled. You have to find out the hard way.
It took them almost two weeks to deliver a new medication. Yes, it was the holidays, but they don't communicate and give you the head's up about anything.
They didn't tell me a medication needed a refill request from the vet until after I ordered and it was refunded. The icing on the cake is our clinic told us their refill numbers were very off. 0 instead of the 2 on the label. 1 instead of the 4. Etc. They claimed it was cause it was imported information from the pharmacy that closed, but they should be updating that.
Auto refills should be based off how long a bottle will last given the daily dosage. Nope. I've been given a day before notification several times that a medication that lasts a month will be refilled two weeks in or sooner. I have had to go to their site so many times to extend these times.
Everything is last minute with them and we run a rescue with many sanctuary animals. We've been forced to do the math (with the help from our vet) and share medication between animals.
Excellent customer service. If you need an expedited delivery (emergencies happen), they make it happen. I’m very happy with Mixlab.
Very pleased with pharmacy at Mixlab. They even contacted the Vet to order a refill.

Kind, easy to work with, very very professional lab. My veterinarian was treating my FIP kitten with a prescription from Mixlab. Both my veterinarian and Mixlab lab did everything humanly possible to save my kitten, and I would never consider dealing with anyone else, in the terrible situation like I had. I will be forever grateful for their efforts! These are the only people you'd want to work with!
I just used them for the first time. Not only was it a fast delivery but they included a little toy for my kitty! She loved it! Thank you for everything!!!
I love this compounding pharmacy.  The products are top of the line.  Their customer service is fabulous.  Shipping is quick.  Thank you for all your hard work!!
Friendly phone and front office staff.
Shockingly easy pet meds
Great company. Very reliable.  Very service oriented!

Great Service from Mixlab. My vet phoned in my 16 and a half year old doggie for a prescription that I didn't quite understand how to administer.  The pharmacist at Mixlab phoned me in a timely manner and explained the choices of administration of the medication.  The pharmacist alleviated my anxiety and spent quite a bit of time explaining the medication so I am comfortable with giving it to my dog.  I highly recommend Mixlab .

Mixlab is great! Orders are filled, shipped and delivered promptly. Their customer service team is excellent. Everyone we spoken to by phone or email has helped resolve our issues right away. We fill a specific prescription through then that needs the flavor added, but we will continue to use them anytime one of our animals needs a scrip filled.

Needed our parakeets heart medicine and it took 2 weeks when it was supposed to be in 24 hours. The vet and i gave all the info multiple times and reached out but they still kept saying pending on the order the whole time. After the vet called them multiple times they finally delivered it the next day, but they already had all the info to place the order in the first place. I understand they might have had reasons for the big delay but they didn't let us know about the status of the order at all and no apologies until the day of the delivery. Very frustrating experience!
